description: R-STRING-1 projected-column count and engine string functions: one snapshot projecting only M, then one projecting ID, M, T, M AS M2, T & '' AS T2, Len(T), Len(M), Mid(M, 3999, 4) and InStr(T, Chr(0)); every value of every row is read by ordinal. Asks whether projection width or duplicated columns change returned BSTRs, and what lengths and positions the engine computes for embedded U+0000 and non-BMP text.
retentionNote: Designed r-str-ado-act probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
